helper_version: A086-v5 independent signed point-edit reconstruction; only own Fraction/formal-log helpers reused

families.parity: m=1..3, representative A={0,..,k-1} for k=1..m, all labelled data points, r=1..3, control point zero; 102 Boolean roots, three full references (306)
families.neutral_unequal: g=-1 iff first three of six data bits are zero; all eight negative data points, r=1..4, control point zero; 32 roots, three references (96)
families.terminal_tensor: all 16 two-bit Boolean terminals, two references, neutral unequal r=1; 32 cases
families.reference_shock: fixed parity m4,k2,r1, exact L=8,32,256 mass/lower certificates; no large-integer factorization

symmetry: All parity supports represented once per size by data-coordinate permutation; proof covers arbitrary references and points, finite test is not an all-reference census; control points translate coefficients without changing masses
arithmetic: Fraction Walsh and physical edge counts; exact formal prime-log identities and likelihood-ratio equalities; outward 48-term atanh log bounds rounded to grid 2^-80
